title: Screens and UI flows (Reactive/Mobile context): create, edit, rename, duplicate, delete; editing an existing screen

capabilities.title: Screens and UI flows: create a screen with its layout, edit an existing screen, rename, duplicate, delete
capabilities.summary: A screen (`IMobileScreen`, Reactive and Mobile contexts) lives in a UI flow (`IMobileFlow:MainFlow`); it is born with its layout (`$scr/#IMobileBlockInstanceWidget`, bound with `set ... SourceBlock IMobileBlock:<Layout>`) whose placeholders (Title, MainContent or Content) receive the content. An existing screen is addressed by path (`IMobileScreen:<Name>/...`) and maintained with set (Title, Description, StyleSheet), link (Roles, RequiredScripts), rename, duplicate and delete after usages.

route.operation: raw verbs: create IMobileScreen under IMobileFlow:<Flow>; set $scr/#IMobileBlockInstanceWidget SourceBlock IMobileBlock:<Layout>; set/link/rename/duplicate/delete/usages by path IMobileScreen:<Name>[/<path>]

alternatives.when: the screen content is easier to write as an HTML fragment inside an existing screen
an archetype (cards/table/detail/form/dashboard) fits and the module references the OutSystemsUI blocks it needs

capabilities.guidance: Widgets, events, block instances and the actions that events call are separate capabilities (ui.widget, ui.input, ui.list, ui.dropdown, ui.event, ui.block-instance; the action body belongs to the logic capabilities). Read the existing screens, layouts and referenced blocks of the module before creating new ones (an --app capture lists them). Renaming a screen or block rewrites references by key; CSS classes, captions and hand-written deep links stay as text. Deleting a screen must first repoint its navigation consumers (usages) and, when it is the module DefaultScreen, set another DefaultScreen. The widget-to-event-to-action chain of a screen is: the widget event (ui.event) points at a screen or at a screen action (the action body is a logic capability).

create.route: create {parent: IMobileFlow:<Flow>, type: IMobileScreen, name, as}; then set $scr/#IMobileBlockInstanceWidget SourceBlock IMobileBlock:<Layout>
preconditions: the parent is a UI flow of the module (MainFlow)
a screen created headless becomes the module DefaultScreen when the module had none

the layout is a block instance born with the screen; bind it to a layout block of the module (ODC: LayoutTopMenu/LayoutBase are blocks of the module itself) and put widgets under its placeholders (Reactive: MainContent; Mobile: Content)

odc.scope: screens in MainFlow with the layout bound and widgets under MainContent (screen-basic, screen-list)

o11.scope: a Reactive screen (screen-form-reactive, reactive-ui fixture) and a Mobile app screen (local-storage-mobile, mobile-ui fixture, placeholder Content)

odc.scope: a flow for an exception handler (switch-exception-handler); a flow with its own theme (theme-script-resource)

set.route: set {target: IMobileScreen:<Name>, prop: Title|Description|StyleSheet, value}; link {from: $scr, connector: Roles|RequiredScripts, to}
preconditions: StyleSheet replaces the screen's own CSS: read it with get first to append
Title is an OutSystems expression (quoted text)

odc.scope: Title, Description, StyleSheet of an inherited screen (screen-block-edit); link Roles (security-settings)
Theme and Description of a flow created by the job

read.route: get/dump by path (IMobileScreen:<Name>, IMobileFlow:<Name>); reader --kind MobileScreen | MobileFlow

odc.scope: get and dump of an inherited screen (screen-block-edit, delete-block)

o11.scope: dump of the created screen (screen-form-reactive); get after linking roles (security-config-reactive)

preconditions: consumers of a screen are navigation destinations (widget events, list items), the module DefaultScreen and the UI flow

odc.scope: 3 consumers of an inherited detail screen: a button OnClick, a list item OnClick and the ESpace DefaultScreen (empty path)

preconditions: the new name must be free in the module

odc.scope: a UI flow that holds an exception handler

o11.scope: cat-b-screen-replace-delete: a UI flow created with a screen, renamed (op 43), read by the new name (op 44)

move.route: move {target, first|last|before|after} (only reorders inside the same parent)
preconditions: move reorders inside the parent; `move {target, into}` changes the parent through the Studio's own move (new key, consumers rebound; a public element is refused)

odc.scope: cat-b-screen-replace-delete: x/y of a screen node on the flow canvas (op 27), read back (op 28)

o11.scope: cat-b-screen-replace-delete: x/y of a screen node on the flow canvas (op 27), read back (op 28)

preconditions: the copy takes a platform suffix; rename it afterwards

odc.scope: a whole screen with its widgets and screen action

replace.route: replace {from, to} (verb exists; not measured on screens)

odc.scope: cat-b-screen-replace-delete: the button and link OnClick of a screen without inputs repointed to another screen of the same contract (op 30: consumers 2, rewired 2, 0 left on the source; usages 2 -> 0, ops 29, 31)

o11.scope: cat-b-screen-replace-delete: the button and link OnClick of a screen without inputs repointed to another screen of the same contract (op 30: consumers 2, rewired 2, 0 left on the source; usages 2 -> 0, ops 29, 31)

preconditions: refused while navigation consumers exist: repoint each consumer Destination first
when the screen is the module DefaultScreen, set another DefaultScreen on @espace first

odc.scope: accepted after repointing the list item OnClick and moving DefaultScreen; refused with 3 consumers named

o11.scope: cat-b-screen-replace-delete: after replace left 0 consumers, the old screen deleted without force (op 36, brokenConsumers 0); it was not the DefaultScreen

limits.text: On ODC the layouts (LayoutTopMenu, LayoutBase) are blocks of the module itself; the ESpace is CrossDevice so the mobile vocabulary applies; a button's caption lives inside IContent (`$btn/#ITextWidget`).
StyleSheet is not watched by the data contract: read it back with get. Deleting a screen must handle navigation consumers and the module DefaultScreen (it appears with an empty path in the refusal).
limits.origin: job:screen-block-edit and job:delete-screen descriptions; kernel/docs/NAO-DA.md DefaultScreen

limits.text: Reordering or inserting sibling widgets can trip the strict merge equivalence gate on DisplayOrder (outcome uncertain: never retry, read the receipt).

Traditional Web screens (IWebScreen) are not an authoring context on ODC: the kernel refuses the web context in a CrossDevice module (ScreenModel.CheckUIRuntime); ODC offers Reactive and Mobile apps only.

differences: the screen is CrossDevice (Reactive web); a Mobile app is a separate context not exercised by any ODC job
a button's caption is inside IContent (`$btn/#ITextWidget`)

limits.text: The context is the module type, not the ss4/ss5 lane: Reactive (CrossDevice) and Mobile (phone app) modules use IMobileScreen; Traditional Web modules use IWebScreen (capability ui.traditional-screen). Phone vs Tablet is not distinguished by the kernel.
The main placeholder of the layout is `MainContent` in Reactive and `Content` in Mobile modules.
A navigation Destination must name a screen that already exists at that point of the job; the preflight refuses forward references with the op numbers.

differences: a button's caption sits beside the button (not inside IContent)
Mobile modules (mobile-ui fixture) and Reactive modules share IMobileScreen; the Mobile layout placeholder is Content

capabilities.title: Comments on a UI flow canvas
capabilities.summary: A comment (`OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IComment`) is a note on a UI flow canvas: Text, IsReminder (Verify then reports a Reminder) and its x/y position. It documents; it changes no behaviour.

route.operation: create {parent: IMobileFlow:<Flow>, type: OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IComment}; set Text/IsReminder; move x/y

o11.note: on O11 11.55.87 a comment created in a UI flow with type UI.Mobile.IComment answers as Logic.Nodes.ICommentNode (GetInterface; measured by cat-b-flow-comment-popover ops 0-8), a type owned by front A: the role is stated on that type and coordinated with A; it has no name, so Verify paths show it as CommentNode

create.route: create {parent: IMobileFlow:<Flow>, type: OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IComment, as} (qualified: the bare IComment also exists in UI.Web)

odc.scope: a canvas comment in MainFlow with Text and IsReminder (Verify reports a Reminder)
dump of MainFlow shows the comment

move.route: move {target, x, y} (position on the flow canvas)

odc.scope: x/y position of the comment on the flow canvas

o11.scope: cat-b-flow-comment-popover: move x/y of the reminder comment (op 7), position read back (op 8)

limits.text: The bare type name IComment is ambiguous (UI.Mobile vs UI.Web vs logic comment nodes): jobs name OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IComment in full.
No O11 suite job creates a flow comment.
